malaysia-national-2014.notes: A university news item: a report that also gives the first three places (partial rankings, scope top 3). The page gives the event as 27 and 28 September 2014 without saying which day the contest ran; the catalogue has 2014-09-27.

sources.evidence: UTAR news page headed 'UTAR tops ACM-ICPC National Programming Contest' giving the first three teams of the 27-28 September 2014 contest hosted by Universiti Teknologi Petronas.

malaysia-national-2016.notes: All ten are Wayback copies of Baekjoon problem pages A-J; titles match the catalogue. Source 7 (E) is a 2017 capture with no submissions yet and the older ACM-ICPC > Asia category path.
